Game Overview

Dont Hit the Sharp! is a tap title where guide a bouncing ball through a vertical gauntlet of spikes in a test of precision and timing. Master your taps to rise higher, keeping the rhythm against a backdrop of mounting tension. Dare to challenge your reflexes as every ascent brings greater risk and thrilling rewards.
